These lines in the BOM stay "estimate" and must be priced by RFQ. [not found]

detailed_notes:
# Hardware supplement (main-session searches, 2026-09-14)
Only one new credible price anchor was found: Goodix GH3220 at USD 2.53/pc on JLCPCB. This is the "cheap Chinese band" PPG AFE and sets the floor for the optical front end in the minimum-viable BOM; ADI/Maxim AFEs (MAX86171/86176) used in premium bands will cost more but no volume price was visible. Battery, charger, and strap unit prices must come from RFQs (Grepow/EVE for cells; TI/Nordic distributors for PMIC; Made-in-China strap factories, 1,000-pc MOQ).
open_questions: RFQ: MAX86171 at 1k/10k; nPM1300 or BQ25180 at 1k/10k; 150 mAh curved LiPo (IEC 62133-certified) at 1k/10k; silicone strap + buckle at 1k/10k.
